paite: TOUPA, na gam tung ah na kipak a; sal a om Jakob na pikik nawnta hi.
heading: Korah tapate phatna La / Nam Hoihna Dia Thumna

paite: Na mite thulimlouhnate na ngaidam a, agitlouhna tengteng uh na khuh khinta hi. Selah
Na thangpaihna tengteng na lamang a; na hehna thupitak na kiheisanta hi.
Hon hondampa Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla, ka tung ua na hehna tawpsak in.
Ka tung uah na heh nilouh dia hia? Na hehna suan tengteng tan in na kitheisak zel dia hia?
Nangmah a na mite akipahtheihna ding un na hon hihhalh nawn kei dia hia?
TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna hon musak inla, na hotdamna leng hon pia in.
TOUPA Pathian thu gen ding ka ngaikhe ding; amite leh amisiangthoute kiang ah khamuanna thu agen dek a, himahleh amau haina lam ah kihei nawnta kei uhen.
Ahotdamna amah kihtate naih in a-om ngeingei nak hi; i gam ua thupina a-omtheihna ding in.
Zahngaihna leh thutak akituak a; diktatna leh kituahna akitawptuah a,
Thutak lei a kipan in adawnkhia a; diktatna in van a pan ahon tansukta hi.
Ahi, TOUPA'N thil hoih ape ding a; i gam in leng athilpou ape ding hi.
Diktatna in ama akai ding a; akhapte lampi ah asiam ding hi.
